name: claude-workflow-kit
description: nil-park's personal Claude Code workflow skills, managed via GitOps.

plugins.name: ko-style
plugins.description: A Stop hook that flags English-calqued Korean in files the turn just edited. Independent of the other plugins.

plugins.name: project-skills-bootstrap
plugins.description: Scaffolds project-level workflow skills (work-cycle, coding-standards, docs-standards, scratch-dir, git-workflow, anti-claudeism) under .agents/skills/ with .claude/skills/ symlinks. A separate bootstrap-fluent-korean skill writes the fluent-korean output style into .claude/settings.json.
